propositions: The packaged code-review guide lines 112–114 incorrectly states that a coverage-gap block requires a maintainer to re-trigger, but contributor self-service re-trigger via `recheck-review` comment is now available.

The stale documentation misdirects contributors to ping maintainers instead of using the self-service `recheck-review` mechanism, creating unnecessary overhead on the primary discoverable on-ramp surface.
The guide must be updated to document `recheck-review` as the contributor self-service re-trigger for coverage-gap infrastructure vetoes and clarify the symmetry with `recheck` (CI).
The update aligns the packaged guide with recent changes to docs/review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and the review-bot runbook that already document the recheck-review capability.
